coaching.headline: One kill on Yin all game: the 18/1 jungler killed every ally, and a 7-5 allied kill lead ended in ten lost structures.

flags.text: Yin dealt 57,065 hero damage through basic-attack items, and only Kaelen bought a damn piece of physical armor.
Skylar sat on level four until shortly before dying, and dealt 3,246 hero damage, the game's lowest.
Renna died to Yin five of six times, the first outside any detected fight before Fangtooth.
Enemy scored the last six kills and took Orb Prime, all three offlane structures and the Core.

focus.title: Armor up and group against the snowball
focus.action: Once Yin snowballs, Renna, Skylar and Gadget buy physical armor next, the team moves in groups until Yin is spotted, and a stalled carry calls for duo-lane cover early.

9.6.call: Won 2-0 as Aurora killed Morigesh and Kaelen killed Yin, and the enemy offlane outer and Mini Prime fell to allies right after. The one fight the team cashed; repeat that collapse.

20.2.call: Two separate plays: Yin killed Aurora, Skylar and Gadget while Kaelen killed Steel, and the enemy took Fangtooth after. Three allied deaths that close together mean conceding the pit and holding the duo inner.

22.4.call: Yin scored all four kills in two separate plays on mid and the duo lane, and the duo inner and two inhibitors fell in the same window. Fight Yin only with all five together.

acc5528b-4e39-4c85-8db4-0f463e35fab0: Mitigated 70,701 damage, the most of all ten players, and opened with first blood on Morigesh. Keep taking the front of fights whenever the carry is alive to follow.
Seven deaths against an own average of 5.2, four to Yin. Next time Yin shows, take the trade only after Lash Kick is used.
Three deaths came on the mid lane, away from the offlane; the third came shortly before the offlane outer fell. Before leaving the offlane for mid, confirm where Yin is.
a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Yin took both Seedlings, all three Fangtooths, the Shaper, a Mini Prime and Orb Prime. When Yin shows on a far lane, start the next objective with the team.
Hero damage per minute of 355 sat well under an own average of 511. In team fights, chain the Hoarfrost root as Kaelen's Frostfall ends.
30343997-9d1b-49cb-8062-7a8110efc340: Four deaths sat under an own average of 6.3, with kills on Valmont, Steel and Morigesh. Keep that discipline whenever the enemy jungler goes missing from the map.
Yin killed the mid laner outside any detected fight, and the mid outer and inner fell right after. When Yin is unseen, play mid from behind the tower.
Backlash reflects projectiles and Quelling Gale halts projectiles; while either is up, lead with ground effects instead.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Farmed 4.1 CS a minute, under an own average of 6.9; Plasma Blade came last of every ally's first item. Clear duo waves until the first item lands.
All four deaths went to Yin, three after the first inhibitor fell. In late fights, stand beside Kaelen so Frostfall can root a diving Yin.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Kill participation of 20% and 2,030 healing is a thin support return. A mage support must stay beside Skylar while Yin is unseen.
Physical damage made up 19,879 of 23,600 hero damage taken, with no physical armor built. If Yin snowballs again, buy physical armor before Entropy.
Four wards matched an own average of 4, but the enemy cleared six allied wards. Before each Fangtooth, ward the pit entrance with a teammate nearby.

matchup: Morigesh was the lane opponent: two kills on Morigesh, first blood included, against one death to Morigesh.
Yin, not Morigesh, scored four of the seven deaths.
build: Basilisk and Fire Blossom, the rest of the 74.1% core beside Forticus, never made the build.
Tainted Blade cuts healing 45% for 3s on any physical damage, the anti-heal answer to Yin's 24,969 healing.
Vainglory was bought after the seventh and final death, too late to matter.
eternal: Lotus grants a random small stat every two minutes and on each takedown.
Nihil leads this offlane field on a toss-up; Lotus has too few games to lead.
Early Bloom with Immaculate is the best Lotus pair here. Sound keep on minors.
augment: Last Winter is clearly the field's best augment for this offlane hero. Sound keep.
Last Winter speeds allies inside the Frostfall zone and shields on landing, rewarding team engages.
crest: Saphir's Mantle's Atlas active grows size and max health, then adds permanent health from damage dealt.
Nyr Warboots is clearly the field's best crest here; Saphir's Mantle ranks second.
improvement: Into Morigesh the field buys Tainted Bastion 34% of the time against 6% usually, at 55.3%.
Crystalline Cuirass goes in 27% of builds into Morigesh against 8% usually, at 57%.
Nyr Warboots over Saphir's Mantle is the field-backed crest swap: a speed and regeneration burst for the Atlas health growth.

matchup: Yin was the jungle opponent and killed this jungler twice, with no kill on Yin in return.
Yin's E passive restores health on every third straight basic attack; Lash Kick slows by 90%.
build: Magnify is one of the 63.6% core with Prophecy and Orion; Prophecy and Orion never made the build.
Tainted Scepter, the anti-heal answer to Yin's healing, finished after all three enemy Fangtooths.
eternal: Nihil is clearly the field's best jungle Eternal for this hero; Lotus ranks second.
Early Bloom with Fragrance is the best Lotus pair; Flawless with Fragrance, the pick here, is the most played.
augment: Glacial Thorns makes Glacial Charge spawn Hoarfrost Crystals that deal damage and root briefly.
Hypothermia leads on a toss-up; Glacial Thorns is the most played. Sound keep.
crest: Tempest's Overcharge active hits up to three nearby heroes each second and heals from the damage.
Epoch leans ahead in this jungle field; Tempest, the most played, trails Saphir's Mantle, Typhoon and Winter's Fury.
improvement: Anti-heal against four self-healing enemy kits was met with Tainted Scepter; no other item change is proven.
Nihil over Lotus is the field-backed Eternal swap: power and armor stacking in long fights, giving up random stat rolls.

matchup: Valmont was the lane opponent: one kill each way, Valmont's coming outside any detected fight.
Yin scored three of the four deaths.
build: Soulbinder is one of the 58% core with Entropy and Tainted Scepter; Entropy and Tainted Scepter never made the build.
Noxia finished after the duo and mid inhibitors had fallen.
eternal: Lotus is clearly the field's best mid Eternal for this hero; Vesh, the most played, trails Demiurge, Aion and Xyris too.
The Tenth Seal with Millennia is the best Vesh pair. Sound keep on minors.
augment: Auto-Lock Amp makes Seek and Destroy home in faster.
Eureka! is clearly the field's best mid augment for this hero; Auto-Lock Amp, the most played, ranks second.
crest: Soulbearer is clearly the field's best mid crest for this hero. Sound keep.
The Anima active grants a shield plus magical lifesteal and movement speed.
improvement: Into Valmont the field buys Tainted Scepter 56% of the time against 25% usually, at 52.3%.
Anti-heal against four self-healing kits and physical armor against Yin were both unmet needs.
Lotus over Vesh is the field-backed Eternal swap: random stats per takedown, giving up the ability-damage burn.

matchup: Duo was this carry and Renna against Legion and Steel; Legion and Steel scored no kill on this carry.
build: Plasma Blade and Vanquisher match the 48.4% most-played core into Legion; Imperator never made the build.
Vanquisher executes a hero taken below 5% health, but finished only after two inhibitors fell.
eternal: Weald fires true-damage missiles after hitting a low-health enemy hero.
Thraex leads Weald on a toss-up in this carry field; Forage with Wind-Rider is the best Weald pair. Sound keep.
augment: Assault MK-II lengthens the Air Assault hover and adds a missile with each attack.
Assault MK-II leads this carry field on a toss-up and is the most played. Sound keep.
crest: Sharpshooter Crest never evolved this game; Pacifier, clearly the field's best carry crest here, evolves from Sharpshooter Crest.
Pacifier's Adrenalize active dashes and empowers the next physical hit.
improvement: Tainted Rounds was the unmet anti-heal answer, cutting healing on basic-attack hits into four self-healing enemy kits.
Physical armor was the other unmet need, with Yin scoring every death.
The 52.9% carry core of Lightning Hawk, Scattershot and Equinox shares no item with this build.

matchup: Duo was this support and Skylar against Legion and Steel; one kill on Legion, and Steel scored no kill all game.
Legion scored the game's final kill on this support; Yin took the other five deaths.

eternal: Lotus leans ahead in this support field; Aion ranks second and Vesh third.
Lich with Mind Rot is the best Vesh pair; Lich with Millennia, the pick here, is the most played.
augment: Netherward shields on every Soulfire cast.
Vital Essence leads Netherward on a toss-up in this support field.
crest: Tranquility is clearly the field's best support crest for this hero. Sound keep.
The Grace active heals nearby allies and grants brief damage mitigation.
Tranquility evolves from Keeper Crest, the Consort Crest upgrade.
improvement: Into Yin the field buys Astral Catalyst 20% of the time against 10% usually, at 49.6%.
Tainted Scepter, physical armor against Yin and magical armor against Steel were all unmet needs.

synergy: Our engage/CC: Gadget Security Gate (root 1s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Rimefang to stun, slow and lay Rimeglass, Winter's Pursuit onto the Frostbitten target to root them, Razorstorm on Rimeglass, then Frostfall to crash down and root the center.
ourKits.winCondition: Fight on his Rimeglass, where Razorstorm boosts his armor and Frostbite deals max health true damage and sets up Winter's Pursuit roots.
ourKits.passive: Heart of Ice makes his abilities leave Rimeglass that slows and burns enemies with Frostbite.
ourKits.playWith: Damage dealers who can follow up on his roots and Frostfall.
ourKits.playAgainst: Step off Rimeglass so Frostbite ends before Winter's Pursuit can root you. Frostfall channels before he leaps, so move out of the center of the landing and leave the Rimestorm; tenacity helps against the roots.

ourKits.combo: Glacial Charge dashes in, Boreal Sweep slows, Hoarfrost roots enemies that touch the ring, then Cryoseism slows and stuns a target before it explodes
ourKits.winCondition: chain slow, root and stun to lock fights down while her Frost Storm grinds max-health damage
ourKits.passive: jumping mid-air leaps her and leaves a Replica that draws tower aggro; hitting a Hero or Monster 4 times summons a Frost Storm
ourKits.playWith: burst damage that turns her long CC chain into kills
ourKits.playAgainst: do not walk into the Hoarfrost ring while it persists; Cryoseism slows before it stuns, so cleanse or tenacity help, and spread so the explosion does not chain; she is weak once Glacial Charge is down

ourKits.combo: Security Gate roots, Sticky Mine is empowered by a basic attack, Seek and Destroy follows the target, then Tesla Dome traps the fight
ourKits.winCondition: root with the gate and hold enemies inside the Tesla Dome while it shreds magical armor
ourKits.passive: FDA stacks from kills, ability hits and takedowns permanently grant magical power
ourKits.playWith: frontline that holds enemies inside the Dome
ourKits.playAgainst: do not walk through Security Gate; leave Tesla Dome early since it grows larger; with no mobility in the kit, dive Gadget after the gate is used; magic armor helps

ourKits.combo: Plasma Grenade slow → Air Assault to hover with extra range → Hypercharge burst → Atomiser to finish a low target
ourKits.winCondition: hover with Air Assault for extra basic range and shred with Hypercharge, refreshing it on takedowns
ourKits.passive: extra jump height; kills make the target explode, much larger from enemy heroes
ourKits.playWith: a frontline that holds enemies in place while she hovers and fires
ourKits.playAgainst: Air Assault is her only reposition, so engage after it ends and she is back on the ground; dodge Plasma Grenade's slow and sidestep the Atomiser channel, which stops on the first hero hit

ourKits.combo: Mortal Coil to pull enemies together and heal from them, Stupor from the air to Mesmerize, Soulfire waves for damage, then Abyssal Rift to teleport in and fire the singularity.
ourKits.winCondition: Collect Essence to grow every ability, then zone fights with Mortal Coil and Abyssal Rift and execute low targets.
ourKits.passive: Echoes of the Damned: nearby deaths can drop Essence (heroes always do) that she collects to empower her abilities, and she can hover after a mid-air jump.
ourKits.playWith: A frontline that keeps enemies inside Mortal Coil and the singularity.
ourKits.playAgainst: Watch for the 1.5s Abyssal Rift channel and leave the target area, and dodge the Stupor orb after she rises. Anti-heal cuts Mortal Coil healing; trade early before she stacks Essence.

enemyKits.combo: Arterial Grip to ground and slow → Bloodbound for attack speed → basics to trigger Hemophagia → Exsanguinate bats to heal
enemyKits.winCondition: bind a target with Arterial Grip and out-sustain them with Hemophagia strikes and Exsanguinate's healing
enemyKits.passive: Hemophagia makes Lilith strike targets hit by his basics or Bloodbound, and takedowns restore mana
enemyKits.playWith: frontliners who keep enemies in range so his bind and bats keep landing
enemyKits.playAgainst: Arterial Grip breaks if you CC him, break line of sight, or get far enough away; buy anti-heal against Exsanguinate and magical armor

enemyKits.combo: Mark a hero, land Hive to slow and stack Pestilence, run through them with Swarm, then cast Curse on the Marked target to cash the Mark in.
enemyKits.winCondition: Keep Pestilence stacked on a squishy with Hive and Swarm, then finish them with Curse while Mark and Swarm heal her through the trade.
enemyKits.passive: Pestilence: her damaging abilities stack a max-health magical damage over time, and Fetid Dagger hits refresh it.
enemyKits.playWith: Lane partners or junglers with setup that hold her Marked target in place for Curse.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Dodge Hive, since its slow sets up everything else, and trade when Swarm is down because it is her damage reduction, speed and main heal. Anti-heal cuts the healing from Mark and Swarm.

enemyKits.combo: Lash Kick in for the slow → Windburn for range and cleave → third-hit max-health damage and heal → Backlash to push away, Quelling Gale to stop projectiles
enemyKits.winCondition: stick with Lash Kick, ramp Rising Storm attack speed and out-trade with Windburn's healing third hits
enemyKits.passive: Rising Storm stacks from basics and Lash Kick grant attack speed
enemyKits.playWith: a team that lets her side-lane and pick off isolated targets
enemyKits.playAgainst: Backlash reflects projectiles and Quelling Gale halts them, so use melee or ground effects while they are up; fight after Lash Kick is used, and buy anti-heal against Windburn

enemyKits.combo: Saturation Charge mines to slow, Frag Order to launch enemies, Orbital Sanction to track them, Rally Point to knock back divers and heal allies.
enemyKits.winCondition: Hold an area with Orbital Sanction and mines while Rally Point keeps his team healthy and his rifle on infinite ammo.
enemyKits.passive: Ballistic Calibration turns bonus attack speed into ability haste and unlocks ability upgrades at item stat thresholds.
enemyKits.playWith: Frontliners who fight inside Rally Point's heal and hold enemies in the Orbital beam.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Stun him while he cooks Frag Order to make him drop it. Bait Rally Point's knockback before engaging, trade when he reloads, and buy anti-heal against Rally Point's heal and armor against his physical damage.

enemyKits.combo: Bull Rush in unstoppable to knock back → Shield Bash stun → Shield Slam knockup and stun, Force Shield to block projectiles
enemyKits.winCondition: engage with Shield Slam or Bull Rush and protect carries with Force Shield's projectile wall
enemyKits.passive: a self-shield that lasts until broken and refreshes when out of damage, plus hybrid armor
enemyKits.playWith: ranged carries he can shield from enemy projectiles, and follow-up damage for his engages
enemyKits.playAgainst: Bull Rush is unstoppable, so do not waste CC into it; walk around Force Shield instead of shooting into it, and fight after Shield Slam is on cooldown

lines: Lead story: Damage well above normal. 2,114 hero damage a minute, more than 98% of Yin jungle players this patch (50% of the team's). The damage came from Sky Splitter, Lightning Hawk, Tainted Rounds.
Yin dealt 57,065 hero damage, 50% of their team's, with +220 physical power from items.
Sky Splitter (item): On Successful Basic Attacks: Deal 5% of Target's Current Health as Damage On-Hit. Reduced to 3.5% for Ranged Heroes. Minimum of 12 Damage.
Lightning Hawk (item): While moving or landing Basic Attacks: Generate stacks of Momentum. At 100 stacks empower your next Basic Attack On-Hit. Deal 40 (+20%) Damage. Slows by 20% for 0.75s.
Tainted Rounds (item): On Successful Basic Attacks: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 3s. Deal (+10%) (+20%) Damage On-Hit. Increases by up to 100% as the Target's Health decreases.
Imperator (item): Critical Strikes deal 30% more damage.
Sustain: 7% lifesteal; 24,969 healing recorded.
Stack (Every basic attack set off): 4 effects on one trigger: Sky Splitter, Lightning Hawk, Tainted Rounds, Dust Devil.
Countered? 1 of the 5 players Yin killed built physical armor (Kaelen). Anti-heal on Kaelen, Aurora. We killed Yin 1 time.
Copy it? Too few Yin jungle games with this Eternal or core this patch to say whether it wins elsewhere.

lines: Lead story: Soaked the fights. 2,619 damage mitigated a minute, more than 93% of Kaelen offlane players this patch.
Frostfall at top rank: 90s base, about 81.8s by the end (9% shorter) from 10 ability haste: Tainted Blade 10.
Kaelen dealt 24,420 hero damage, 36% of their team's, with +60 physical power from items.
Forticus (item): Upon taking Hero damage: Gain a (+8%) Shield for 3.5s.
Forticus (item): Upon damaging or being damaged by Heroes: For the next 3s, gain Stats each second: (+0.6% Base Health) additional Max Health, +4 Movement Speed and +0.5% Size.
Tainted Blade (item): On dealing Physical Damage: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 3s.
Tainted Blade (item): On dealing Ability Damage to a Blighted Target: Cause them to take 5% more damage for 3s.
Sustain: Forticus: Upon taking Hero damage: Gain a (+8%) Shield for 3.5s.; Forticus: Shield Activations: Hero Combat Time:; 3,226 healing recorded.
Toughness: +1175 health, +100 physical armor, +40 magical armor, +25% tenacity; took 48,588 damage, mitigated 70,701, died 7 times.
Stack (Kept alive in fights): 2 effects on one trigger: Aegis Of Agawar, Forticus. Together they made staying in a long fight cheaper: more armor, shields or healing the longer it went.
Countered? 1 of the 3 players Kaelen killed built physical armor (Steel). We killed Kaelen 7 times.
Copy it? Too few Kaelen offlane games with this Eternal or core this patch to say whether it wins elsewhere.

evidence: From 23.9m to 26.8m every kill was theirs (kills stood 10-17 before the run).
Yin 18/1/5, 78% of their kills, 57065 hero damage (the most in the game).
Killed Renna 5, Kaelen 4, Skylar 4, Gadget 3, Aurora 2.
Hard CC: Backlash (knockback).
Mobility: Lash Kick.
Self-healing in the kit (Windburn).
Play against: Backlash reflects projectiles and Quelling Gale halts them, so use melee or ground effects while they are up; fight after Lash Kick is used, and buy anti-heal against Windburn
Answers: Physical armor on whoever it kept killing. Anti-heal: Tainted Guard or Tainted Bastion, or Tainted Scepter.

bullets: Rising Storm stacked attack speed from basic attacks on heroes and monsters, so Sky Splitter and Tainted Rounds hit more often and Lightning Hawk charged faster.
Thraex marked the last hero Yin's basic attacks hit for 3s, raising Yin's damage on that hero; Ferocity's hero-combat attack speed stacked with Rising Storm, feeding Sky Splitter.
Savage Strikes added physical damage to each basic attack, boosted for a short time after hitting heroes, and healed Yin for that damage, alongside Windburn's third-hit heal.
Razorstorm's passive armor grows while Kaelen stands on Rimeglass, so fighting on Rimeglass stacked with the Forticus shield, which comes on hero damage with a cooldown.
Immaculate cut damage near full health as fights opened, beside Razorstorm's armor; Lotus added random stat stacks over time and per takedown; Early Bloom added a level.
Tainted Blade cut healing on targets of Kaelen's physical damage, and Tainted Blade's ability haste shortened Frostfall's cooldown, returning the Frostbite-filled Rimestorm sooner.
